text_block_list.text:
The weather forecast says it's going to rain
tonight, so I finish up my
work and try to
get right home, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Behold! Even from this terrestrial plane, I
bring you into my majestic
light!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I hear a familiar voice coming from
somewhere nearby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You think you're the only lightbringer?
Then gaze upon my shining
glory! 'Tis the
luminance of the one true Centurial
Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О is at the riverside in her
usual grandiosity.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't you here, Trainer. I'm sure
you're not surprised to see
that I'm having
a battle of beauty with the evening star.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Beauty, after all, is like racing against a
fierce opponent; the struggle
for victory
serves to make it stronger.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I take time every day to find a worthy foe
to hone my skills against.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now, back to our battle, evening star!
Here I stand, so show me your
greatest
brilliance!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Opera O faces the sky, striking a pose.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Twinkle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...But the star seems to hide behind the
coming rain clouds.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was a battle for the ages.
Trainer, send the evening off
with a round
of applause.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It is, and with its end comes my victory.
You saw it yourself. Before my
magnificent
self, the star fled in shame!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
This means my beauty now makes even the
stars blush in
embarrassment. Who shall I
challenge next? The moon... No, the sun

itself!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
As it's going to rain soon, the moon is too
shy tonight for a battle
unfortunately.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Alas! Is there no one formidable enough to
rival me? Trainer, do you
know anyone
worthy?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Heh, I understand it must be a most difficult question. Only one person could ever stand as my equal—me.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
So be it. I will have to bear my solitude
and find comfort in the cool
night breeze
as I search for my next rival.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Hm... I wonder if she feels lonely.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm her trainer—there must be something I
can do for her. She says
only she can stand
against herself, so...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: You could... battle yourself, for real.

text_block_list.text: What? You would have me fight me?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
That might be the greatest thought in your
life! I, the shining light,
did not know how
truly bright I am!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What a fantastic idea! That's exactly what
I'll do!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And so, I end up being called to the dance
studio on my day off...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha ha! Watch carefully,
Trainer. I shall defeat any
opponent with
ease, even myself.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
You'll have a premium seat to witness my
spectacular victory. Now let
the battle
begin. First... a pose showdown!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She suddenly starts a heated battle of
aesthetics with the T.M. Opera
O in the
mirror.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... How can this be? I had no idea an opponent of such strength and beauty existed.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She matches my pace at every step, with
the exact same timing. Even
her poses are
the same as mine, but how?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Answer me, mirror self!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It could be that she's thinking the same
thing as I am. Have it your
way. I never
truly believed our struggle would end here
anyway!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
On to the next challenge! That's right—a
staring contest!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Pft, hehe... Haaah ha ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Foiled once again! How can I keep from
smiling before such
immeasurable beauty?
I'm at my wit's end!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Blasted fate. It's another draw... You're
good—I grant you that—my
mirror world
self!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But the prelude of your defeat draws near!
Our destinies will be
decided in this final
duel... Red light, green light!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: You don't know when I'll saaay... red light!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Gah?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I'm overwhelmed. The glamour of this
Umamusume is too much!
Please, I must
know your name...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I mustn't! To be tagged means losing the
battle! But why can't I stop
myself from
reaching for her hand?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I've been bested, Trainer. My mirror self
had even me bound by her
spell.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Oh, the insult... I curse her! I detest how
beautiful the mirror me is!
I've never felt so
strongly!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But you won't find me weeping over it.
You'll see. One day I will
triumph over
myself. For I shall be Over—
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ngah! The beauty—it burns!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I was naive to underestimate your
true power, mirror self. Truly,
striving to
surpass you may lead to my death...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She's collapsed on the floor, completely
immobile. Being defeated by
herself
must've really vexed her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: ...Come on, Opera. You can do it.

text_block_list.text:
You're right. "Defeat" isn't in my
vocabulary. I am determined to seize
glory
next time.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
You know... You're rather something,
Trainer. My respect for you has
grown
immensely.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Because you continue to gaze at me
unblinkingly, my blinding
radiance be
damned.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
If that strength of mind isn't to be
respected, I don't know what is.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And if I'm to defeat myself, I, too, must
acquire that iron will. Yet...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Those looks are just too appealing... O me
in the mirror, you are truly
the rival to end
all rivals!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О may have met the greatest
opponent of her life in that
mirror... Wait,
what am I saying?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
